Subject:  
Submission of Weblink of audio recording of Investor Call under 
Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we hereby submit the weblink of audio recording of the investor 
call/earnings call conducted by Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited (GMDC) 
on 23rd May, 2025, post the announcement of audited annual financial results (both 
standalone and consolidated) for the quarter/year ended on 31st March, 2025. 
 
The audio recording of the investor call is available at the following link: 
 
https://www.gmdcltd.com/investors/audio-link-to-the-gmdcs-conference-call/  
 
The 
same

on

at: 
www.gmdcltd.com

Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited, 
 
 
 
Joel Evans  
Company Secretary
